auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Use the account you already have on one of your media services.
auth.subtitle_internal: Signing in with this gateway's own account.
auth.provider_only: The only way in this gateway offers right now.
auth.redirect_hint: You will be sent to {provider} to finish signing in.
auth.no_provider_text: This gateway has no authentication provider yet. Register a media service, or create the first internal account from the command line, then reload this page.

setup.title: First run
setup.tagline: One gateway for every media server you and your friends run.
setup.intro: This gateway keeps the media servers in this house — and your friends' — in step with one another. Nothing has been claimed yet, so there is one thing to do: create the account you will sign in with.

promise.index: Index the Jellyfin and Plex servers you already run.
promise.friends: Link a friend's gateway, and see what they choose to share.
promise.pull: Pull what is missing here, into the right library, named the way yours are.

setup.account_help: It is an administrator, and until a media service is registered it is the only way in.
setup.display_name_hint: Optional. What this interface calls you; the username is what you sign in with.
setup.password_hint: At least {min} characters. This gateway may well end up reachable from outside the house.
setup.why_no_default: There is no default password here on purpose: one shipped on something reachable from a network is how strangers find a gateway. This screen is open only while no account exists, and closes for good once one does.
setup.already_claimed: This gateway has just been claimed. Sign in with the account that was created.
setup.failed: The account could not be created.

common.error_text: The gateway could not answer. Try again in a moment.
common.placeholder: This page is not built yet.
common.copy_failed: Copying failed. Select the value and copy it by hand.

browse.current_not_writable: The gateway cannot write into this folder, so nothing would ever land here.
browse.truncated: Showing the first {count} folders. Type the path if the one you want is not listed.

describe.monthly_at: On day {day} of each month, at {time}.

dashboard.no_jobs_text: Create a plan, or start a one-off sync from a media page.

problem.service_unauthorized: {name} refused the gateway — check its token

library.title: Libraries
library.subtitle: Everything the gateway has indexed, across every service.
library.empty_text: No indexed media matches these filters. Widen them, or scan a service first.
library.empty_service_text: This service reported no library. Scan it, or check its credentials.
library.section_empty: Nothing in this category matches these filters.
library.categories_hint: Libraries of the same name, on every server, seen as one.
library.naming_help: The name is this gateway's own: the service keeps the one it reports, and a rescan cannot undo it. The order is lowest first, and also decides which category wins when the same media is filed in two.
library.category_merged: merged with {count} other library of that name | merged with {count} other libraries of that name
library.category_unknown: The categories have not been read yet.
library.derived_hint: Worked out from the root stated on the service. Type a path here only if this library needs a different one.
library.local_path_hint: Where the gateway sees these files. It must be the same directory your media server reads.
library.check_failed: This path could not be checked.
library.unwritable_warning: {count} of these libraries cannot be written to, so nothing can be pulled into them.

problem.no_path: No local path is set, so the gateway cannot write into this library.
problem.missing: This path does not exist as the gateway sees it.
problem.unreadable: The gateway cannot read this path.
problem.not_writable: The gateway cannot write here, so no transfer can land in this library.

category.empty: No category yet. Register a media service and scan it; its libraries appear here.

media.no_children_text: This item has no season, episode or member in the index.

origin_help.local: A server this gateway can write into.
origin_help.direct: A remote server registered here — a second machine of yours, or a public one.
origin_help.friend: Through a peer you linked to yourself.
origin_help.friend_of_friend: Through a peer one of your friends introduced. Nobody here ever agreed to them.

source.title: Pull from
source.held_here: One of your own services holds this.

version.title: Versions
version.nothing_to_pull: nothing to pull — only we have it
version.transfer_count: no version chosen — the configured priority decides | one version chosen, one transfer | {count} versions chosen, {count} transfers

match.title: Correlations
match.empty_text: Nothing else in the index has been matched with this item yet.

override.title: Correct this item
override.intro: What a media server got wrong, corrected here and nowhere else. The correction reaches the category it appears under, the correlations and the filing — and the next rescan re-applies it instead of undoing it.
override.clear_help: Leaving a field alone keeps what the service said. The eraser removes the value entirely, which is how you get rid of a year a scraper invented.
override.library_hint: Which library it belongs to, and so which category it appears under.
override.identifiers_hint: What makes a correlation reliable: two servers number the same episode differently and still agree on a TVDB identifier.
override.restored: The service's own answer is back.
override.changed_count: nothing changed | {count} field changed | {count} fields changed

field.title: Title
field.series_title_hint: For an episode: the name its folder is named after.

state.cleared: Cleared: this field stays empty whatever the service says.
state.cleared_was: Cleared: the service says “{value}”, and this gateway ignores it.

service.subtitle: The media servers this gateway reads from and writes to.
service.empty_text: Register the Jellyfin or Plex you already run, and the gateway will index it.
service.remove_confirm: {name} and everything indexed from it will be removed from the gateway. The files themselves are not touched.
service.scan_started: A full scan has started. It reports its progress here.

field.name: Name
field.base_url_hint: Including the port, such as http://192.168.0.10:8096
field.token_hint: Created in the media server itself. It is never shown again once saved.
field.token_hint_edit: Leave empty to keep the token already registered.
field.priority_hint: Lowest first when the same media is available from several services.
field.roots: Where its files are, for us
field.roots_hint: The server reports its own paths. State its root once here and every library under it works out where this gateway reaches the same files — instead of one path to type per library. A library that needs something else keeps a path of its own.
field.remote_root: Root, as the server reports it
field.remote_root_hint: What the media server calls it, such as /media
field.local_root_hint: Where this gateway reaches it, such as /mnt/nas
field.auth_provider_hint: Its accounts become ways into this gateway.

probe.failed: The service did not answer, or refused the credentials.
probe.libraries: no library found | {count} library found | {count} libraries found
probe.unauthorized: The service answered but refused these credentials. Check the token.
probe.unreachable: The service could not be reached at this address.

mode_hint.local: The gateway can write into these, so they are the only possible destinations.
mode_hint.remote: Servers you have an account on. Read-only: it is somebody else’s disk.
mode_hint.peer: Friends’ gateways. They show what their owner chose to share, and nothing more.

peer.subtitle: The other gateways this one is linked to.
peer.name: Name
peer.empty_text: Paste a friend's fingerprint, or hand them an invitation — either links the two gateways.
peer.relay_hint: This link goes through the rendezvous, whose bandwidth is shared by everyone using it.
peer.remove_confirm: The link with {name} will be dropped. Anything already pulled from them stays.
peer.no_services_text: This peer has not shared any service with us, or has not been reached yet.

direction.incoming_hint: This gateway asked to link with yours. Accept it, or block them.
direction.outgoing_hint: Asked. Nothing to do here until they accept.

add.hint: What a link needs is that each side knows the other's fingerprint. Paste theirs, and they get a request showing yours.
add.fingerprint_hint: As their own gateway displays it, under "This gateway".
add.address_hint: Optional. Tried first when you know it; the rendezvous finds them otherwise.

identity.title: This gateway
identity.node_id_help: This gateway's stable name across the shared network. Generated once, and deliberately not the fingerprint: rotating a key must not make this look like a new participant. It is what to quote when an announcement from a friend of a friend goes round in circles.
identity.direct_ok: Direct connections are possible, so transfers do not go through the relay.
identity.relay_only: Only relayed links are possible. Everything works, but transfers share the rendezvous with everybody else using it. Making this gateway reachable — one port, the one the interface is on — would remove that.

invite.title: Linking two gateways
invite.create_hint: An invitation carries this gateway's fingerprint and a one-shot secret. It expires, and it burns on use.
invite.one_shot: it can only be used once.
invite.name: Name this peer
invite.name_hint: Optional. How this gateway will be called in your lists.

catalogue.empty_text: This library is empty, or nothing in it is shared with us.

peer.banned: Banned. That key cannot come back on its own.
peer.unbanned: Ban lifted. They may ask again.
peer.remove_ban: Also refuse this key for good
peer.remove_ban_hint: Removing alone lets them ask again, which is usually what you want when a friend rebuilds their gateway.
peer.ban_confirm: {name} will be unlinked, and their key refused — by request, by invitation, and through a friend.
peer.ban_reason_hint: For whoever reads this list a year from now
peer.unban_confirm: {name} will be able to ask again. It links nobody by itself.

bans.title: Refused keys
bans.hint: A ban outlives the peer it came from: the key cannot return by request, by invitation, or through a friend.

depth.hops_via: one hop away, through {peer} | {count} hops away, through {peer}

notification.title: Notification channels
notification.help: A sync runs for hours and finishes at four in the morning. A channel is how this gateway tells you about it without a browser tab left open.
notification.empty: No channel yet, so nothing is sent anywhere.
notification.remove_confirm: Remove {name}? Nothing will ever be sent through it again.
notification.test_ok: Delivered. Look at the device it was sent to.
notification.name: Name
notification.name_help: Yours to choose. It appears on this screen and nowhere else.
notification.enabled_help: A channel switched off keeps its settings and sends nothing.

kind_help.ntfy: A push to a phone. No account and no app to install from us: a server address and a topic name only your household knows.
kind_help.smtp: An ordinary email through a mail server you already have. Slower than a push, and it reaches whatever already notifies you.

notification.events_all: Nothing ticked means everything, including the events added in later versions.

event.placement_unconfigured: A file landed where nobody chose

event_help.placement_unconfigured: Nothing named a destination, so it went to the default library or the fallback folder. Nothing else would ever say a word about it.
event_help.disk_full: Before a byte moves, while freeing space still helps.
event_help.peer_request: A request nobody sees is a request nobody answers.

field_help.topic: Anything you like, and hard to guess: on a public server whoever knows the name reads the messages.
field_help.token: Only for a server that asks for one.
field_help.port: 587 for submission with STARTTLS, 465 for implicit TLS.
field_help.secure: On for 465, off for 587. Set from the port until you change it.
field_help.from: The address the message is sent from. Some servers refuse anything else.
field_help.to: One address, where the messages go.

notification.secret_kept: Left empty, the stored value is kept.

share.subtitle: What this gateway exposes, decided one library at a time.
share.no_libraries_text: Register a service first; its libraries appear here.
share.followed_default: This library follows the gateway default again.
share.allowed_hint: These peers see this library whatever the rule above says.
share.denied_hint: These peers never see it, whatever the rule above says.
share.rate_limit_hint: How much this library serves, such as 2M. Empty means no cap.

rate_summary.global: Everything this gateway sends is capped at {rate}.
rate_summary.global_none: No global upload cap: this gateway sends as fast as the link allows.
rate_summary.libraries: Libraries that cap what they serve on their own:
rate_summary.libraries_none: No library caps what it serves on its own.

visibility_help.private: Nothing is shared with anybody, whatever the gateway default says.
visibility_help.friends: The gateways you linked to yourself.
visibility_help.friends_of_friends: Your peers, and the peers they introduce.

origin.default_hint: Nobody has decided about this library, so it follows the gateway default. Change that default and this library moves with it.
origin.set_hint: Somebody chose this for this library alone. The gateway default no longer moves it.
origin.not_ours_hint: This library lives on a service that is not ours, so it stays private whatever the default says. Sharing it would mean relaying somebody else's server, and that is agreed to one library at a time.

audit.title: What a peer would see
audit.hint: Pick a peer to see exactly what this gateway would show them, before you save.
audit.nothing_text: This peer sees none of your libraries.

user.subtitle: Who can sign in, and what they are allowed to do.
user.empty_text: Nothing has signed in to this gateway yet.
user.mirrored_hint: Mirrored from a media service: the gateway does not own the username or the password, so neither can be changed here. The role can.
user.remove_confirm: {name} will no longer be able to sign in to this gateway.

settings.subtitle: How this gateway places, pulls and indexes.

destination.rule_title: How the gateway decides where a file goes
destination.rule_existing: A series you already have keeps its own folder. A new episode is filed beside its siblings, in that library's own spelling of a season folder — Saison 1 stays Saison 1.
destination.rule_category: Otherwise, the library set for that category in the table below.
destination.rule_fixed: The first step is not a setting and cannot be turned off. Splitting one season across two folders is worse than either answer on its own, so a series that already has a home keeps it.
destination.global_help: Where anything no category names is filed. Set this one and you never need to open the table.
destination.none: No library here can receive files. A destination has to be a library on one of your own services that this gateway can write into.
destination.table_help: One row per category. A row you leave alone uses the default destination above.
destination.fallback_unset: whatever library can take it — nothing is set above

rejected.not_ours: {library} on {service} cannot be offered: it is on somebody else's server, and this gateway cannot write there.
rejected.not_writable: {library} on {service} cannot be offered: this gateway cannot write into its folder.

destination.fixed_path_active: Everything is currently going to {path}, whatever it is — an older setting that overrules everything on this page. Nothing above applies until it is cleared.

settings.public_url_help: How friends reach this gateway from outside — the address only, such as https://mcs.example.org. It is what an invitation, a share link and an announce carry; without it an invitation names this gateway and gives nobody a way to reach it.
settings.public_url_suggested: Suggested from the address you are using right now ({origin}). Change it if your friends reach this gateway under another name.
settings.default_target_help: An absolute path this gateway can write to, for the case a library cannot express — a staging folder outside every library. Used only when neither a category nor the default destination library answers.

naming_help.source: The file arrives named as the source named it.
naming_help.local: Renamed the way your own library already names things.

settings.pull_metadata_help: Copies artwork, subtitles and .nfo files alongside the media.
settings.prefer_source_metadata_help: Overwrites local metadata when the source's is richer.
settings.max_parallel_help: How many files are pulled at the same time.
settings.max_connections_help: How many ranges one transfer asks a single source for at once.
settings.chunk_size_help: How much a piece is worth re-fetching when verification fails, such as 4M.
settings.rate_limit_help: Such as 10M. Empty means no cap.
settings.upload_rate_limit_help: Such as 10M. Empty means no cap. It throttles everything this gateway sends, peers pulling from it included.
settings.categories_help: Libraries of the same name are one category, and this is the order they appear in. A library is renamed or reordered on the service that holds it.
settings.history_days_help: In days. After that they leave the queue.
settings.swarm_help: Several peers holding the same file can feed one transfer together.
settings.rendezvous_help: The server that introduces two gateways so they can open a direct link.
settings.match_threshold_help: Below this score a match is proposed rather than applied.
settings.refresh_interval_help: How often each service is asked what is new. Cheap, and the reason the index stays current.
settings.cache_ttl_help: How long a service answer stays good. Long enough that ten open tabs cost one request.
settings.full_scan_help: A refresh only sees what a service reports as new. Empty disables the scheduled pass; the button always works.
settings.instance_name_help: What your friends see instead of the machine's hostname. Inside a container that hostname is a random string.
settings.peer_max_depth_help: Hops allowed from here: 1 is friends only, 2 their friends, and so on.
settings.peer_max_depth_pinned: Fixed by this deployment’s environment and cannot be changed here.
settings.peer_max_depth_per_peer: A ceiling over the whole gateway. Each peer can be held shorter on its own row, and no setting here can reach past what somebody else allowed.
settings.write_nfo: Write an .nfo when the source has none
settings.write_nfo_help: A source often keeps its metadata in its own database and nothing on disk, so copying gives the file and none of the facts — and your media server then re-identifies the episode from its filename. Never replaces a document you already have.
settings.default_share_help: Applies the moment a scan finds a library, so a friend who links to this gateway is not met with an empty shelf.
settings.default_share_scope: Only libraries on your own services. One on somebody else’s server stays private whatever this says — sharing it on would spend your bandwidth on an access granted to you, not to the people you would hand it to.

sync.subtitle: Standing intents, and what they have actually done.
sync.no_plans_text: A plan says what to pull, from where, to where — manually, on a schedule, or whenever a source announces something new.
sync.no_jobs_text: Runs appear here as soon as a plan fires or a sync is started by hand.

state_help.local_only: Held here and on no other service we know of.
state_help.missing: Another service has it, this one does not. A sync fills it in.
state_help.in_sync: Present on both sides, same version.
state_help.outdated: Held here, but a better version exists elsewhere.
state_help.conflict: Two versions that cannot be ordered — different cuts or languages.
state_help.syncing: A transfer is running for this item.
state_help.unknown: Not correlated against the other services yet.

trigger_help.manual: Runs only when somebody presses run.
trigger_help.schedule: Runs on the cron expression below.
trigger_help.on_new: Runs whenever a source announces something that matches the filters.

plan.subtitle: What to pull, from where, to where.
plan.name: Name
plan.sources_default: No source pinned: the plan follows the service priority set in the settings, which is what most people want.
plan.target_hint: Empty means: beside our own copy, or the default target for that kind.
plan.root_hint: Optional. The identifier of a series or collection, to restrict the plan to that subtree.
plan.max_bytes_hint: Such as 8G. Empty means no limit.
plan.replace_outdated: Also replace a local file when a better one exists
plan.remove_confirm: {name} will stop running. Nothing already pulled is touched.

preview.title: What this would pull
preview.summary: Nothing to pull | {count} item to pull | {count} items to pull
preview.empty_text: With these sources and filters, everything is already here.

companions.title: Beside the file
companions.never_checked_help: The gateway reads what sits beside a file only in a library it was told where to find. This says nothing about whether the files are there.

bandwidth.title: Bandwidth
bandwidth.hint: Applied to every transfer together, as soon as it is set. An empty field means no cap.

transfer.subtitle: What is being pulled, from whom, and what went wrong.
transfer.empty_text: Nothing is being pulled. Start a sync, or pull an item from a media page.
transfer.paused_hint: Holding where it stopped: its pieces are kept, and resuming carries on from here.
transfer.queue_paused: The queue is paused — {count} transfers are holding where they stopped.
transfer.replanned: The item has been planned again.
transfer.revalidated: A transfer changed its mind after asking its source.
transfer.verify_ok: The file on disk is intact.
transfer.verify_corrupt: The file on disk does not match. Repair will re-fetch only the bad pieces.

verification.corrupt: Verified: {count} pieces do not match and have to come back.

unconfigured.title: {count} file landed where nobody chose | {count} files landed where nobody chose
unconfigured.hint: Their transfers succeeded, so nothing else reports them. Say where they belong, or say it once for the whole category.
unconfigured.remembered: Set. Everything in that category goes there from now on.

reason.default_library: No destination is set for the category {category}, so it went to the default destination library.
reason.fallback_path: No destination is set for the category {category} and there is no default destination library, so it went to the fallback folder.
reason.any_writable: Nothing is set for the category {category}, and there is no default destination or fallback folder either, so it went to the first library that could take it.

no_category.default_library: This item's library belongs to no category, so the default destination library took it.
no_category.fallback_path: This item's library belongs to no category and there is no default destination library, so it went to the fallback folder.
no_category.any_writable: This item's library belongs to no category, and nothing else was set either, so it went to the first library that could take it.

chunks.title: Pieces
chunks.empty: This transfer has no piece map yet.

error_kind.source_gone: The source no longer holds it
error_kind.checksum_mismatch: The pieces do not match their hashes
error_kind.permission_denied: The gateway may not write there
error_kind.unknown: It stopped for an unclear reason

error_help.source_gone: It was moved, deleted or re-encoded. Another source has to be found; trying again would reach the same absence.
error_help.source_unauthorized: The far end answered and said no. Its credentials are what has to change.
error_help.network: A transient failure — this is the one that a retry really does fix.
error_help.checksum_mismatch: Pieces are verified one by one, so a repair costs megabytes rather than the whole file.
error_help.disk_full: The target library has no room. Another library, or some space, is needed.
error_help.permission_denied: The directory exists but the gateway cannot write into it.
error_help.target_missing: The directory the file was going to no longer exists.
error_help.cancelled: Somebody stopped it. It can be started again.
error_help.unknown: Verifying what is on disk is the cheapest way to learn more.

retarget.title: Pull it somewhere else
retarget.hint: The item will be planned again into the library you choose. Only libraries the gateway can write to are offered.

revalidation.title: Why this transfer changed its mind
revalidation.empty: Nothing has been asked of the sources for this transfer.

action.follow_move: follow it to its new path

pages.not_found_text: There is nothing at this address.

validators.password: Use at least {length} characters, with a digit, a lowercase and an uppercase letter.
validators.password_class: Use at least {numClasses} different kinds of character.
validators.reg_exp: This value does not match the expected format ({source}).
validators.repeat_field: The two values do not match.
validators.url_with_port: Enter a full address, such as http://192.168.0.10:8096.
validators.cron: Enter a valid cron expression, such as 0 4 * * *.
validators.absolute_path: Enter an absolute path, such as /media/movies.
validators.byte_size: Enter a size such as 512M, 2G or a plain number of bytes.
validators.file_size: Each file must be at most {size}.
validators.file_formats: This file type is not accepted.

error.general: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

auth.provider_unknown: This sign-in method is not available any more.
auth.provider_unreachable: The service that authenticates you did not answer.
auth.session_expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
auth.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.

service.not_found: This media service no longer exists.
service.unreachable: The media service did not answer.
service.resource_not_found: The media service answered, and no longer holds this item.
service.unauthorized: The gateway was refused by this media service. Check its token.
service.duplicate: This media service is already registered.
service.handler_unknown: This kind of media service is not supported.
service.auth_unsupported: A peer cannot sign anyone in; choose a media server instead.

library.path_unreadable: The gateway cannot read this path.
library.path_not_writable: The gateway cannot write to this path.

media.not_found: This media item no longer exists.

peer.awaiting_them: They have not answered yet, so there is nothing to approve.
peer.protocol_unsupported: This peer speaks a version of the protocol this gateway does not know.
peer.method_unsupported: This peer asked for something this gateway does not implement.
peer.banned: This fingerprint is on the ban list. Lift the ban before linking to them again.
peer.ban_not_found: Nothing on the ban list matches that fingerprint.

sync.plan_not_found: This sync plan no longer exists.
sync.job_not_found: This sync run no longer exists.

transfer.not_resumable: This transfer cannot be resumed and has to start over.
transfer.no_space: Not enough free space on the target library.
transfer.checksum_mismatch: The downloaded file does not match its checksum.
transfer.destination_full: The destination filled up while the file was being moved into it. Nothing is lost: free some space and resume, and the move carries on from where it stopped.
transfer.target_occupied: Something else already occupies the path this file would land on, and no free name could be built. Nothing was overwritten.
transfer.destination_invalid: A destination has to be a library on one of your own services. A folder nothing scans accepts the file and then shows it to nobody.

settings.target_path_invalid: Enter an absolute path, such as /media/incoming.
settings.target_path_not_writable: The gateway cannot write to this folder.
settings.pinned: This setting is fixed by the deployment and cannot be changed here.

user.last_admin: This is the last administrator. Give the role to somebody else first.

share.relay_not_agreed: A library held on another gateway can only be shared by relaying it. Allow relaying on this share first.

filesystem.path_outside_root: That folder is outside the directories this gateway may browse.
filesystem.path_unreadable: The gateway cannot read that folder.

notification.channel_not_found: This notification channel no longer exists.
notification.config_invalid: This channel cannot work with these settings.
notification.handler_unknown: This kind of notification channel is not supported.
notification.send_failed: The channel did not deliver the message.

indications.placement: Where pulled media lands when nothing more specific says otherwise.
indications.match_threshold: Below this score a correlation is proposed rather than applied.
indications.full_scan_cron: A refresh only sees what a service reports as new; a full pass catches files moved or re-encoded in place.
